overview: The system is composed of two components: a React single-page application (frontend) and a Go REST API backend. The frontend communicates exclusively with the backend over HTTPS using JWT-based authentication. All task, category, and user data is persisted in a PostgreSQL database managed by the backend service.
requirements: Users can register with a unique email and password (min 8 chars, 1 number, 1 special character).
Users can log in and receive a session token; sessions expire after 30 minutes of inactivity.
Users can log out, invalidating their session.
Users can request a password reset link sent to their registered email.
Users can update their display name, email, and password while authenticated.
Users can delete their account, permanently removing all associated tasks and categories.
Each user can only access their own tasks and categories.
Users can create tasks with: title (1–200 chars, required), description (optional), due date/time (optional), category (optional), priority (low/medium/high, default medium).
Users can view, edit, and delete their tasks; deletion requires confirmation.
Users can mark tasks complete or incomplete.
Every task stores created_at and updated_at timestamps.
Users can create categories with a unique-per-user name and optional color label.
Users can rename or delete categories; deleting a category uncategorizes its tasks.
Users can filter tasks by category, completion status, priority, due date range (today/this week/overdue), and keyword search (title or description).
Combined filters must all apply simultaneously.
Users can sort tasks by due date, creation date, priority, or title (ascending/descending).
Overdue tasks (past due date and incomplete) must be clearly indicated.
Tasks without a due date are clearly indicated as undated.
All API responses must be returned within acceptable latency to support 500 concurrent users.
Passwords must be stored using a secure one-way hashing algorithm (bcrypt).
All data in transit must be encrypted (HTTPS).
Input must be validated on both the client side and server side.
The frontend must be responsive and usable on modern desktop and mobile browsers.
All pages must load and become interactive within 2 seconds under normal network conditions.
The application must display clear, user-friendly error messages for all failure states.

components.name: task-api
components.openAPISpec:
openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Task API
  version: 1.0.0
servers:
  - url: http://localhost:9090
paths:
  /health:
    get:
      summary: Health check
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: object
                properties:
                  status:
                    type: string
                    example: ok

  /api/auth/register:
    post:
      summary: Register a new user
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [email, password]
              properties:
                email:
                  type: string
                  format: email
                password:
                  type: string
                  minLength: 8
                display_name:
                  type: string
      responses:
        '201':
          description: User created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthResponse'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'
        '409':
          description: Email already in use

  /api/auth/login:
    post:
      summary: Log in
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [email, password]
              properties:
                email:
                  type: string
                password:
                  type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Authenticated
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuthResponse'
        '401':
          description: Invalid credentials

  /api/auth/logout:
    post:
      summary: Log out
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Session ended

  /api/auth/password-reset/request:
    post:
      summary: Request password reset email
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [email]
              properties:
                email:
                  type: string
                  format: email
      responses:
        '202':
          description: Reset email sent if account exists

  /api/auth/password-reset/confirm:
    post:
      summary: Confirm password reset with token
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [token, password]
              properties:
                token:
                  type: string
                password:
                  type: string
                  minLength: 8
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Password updated
        '400':
          description: Invalid or expired token

  /api/users/me:
    get:
      summary: Get current user profile
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: User profile
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
    patch:
      summary: Update display name or email
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                display_name:
                  type: string
                email:
                  type: string
                  format: email
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated user
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
    delete:
      summary: Delete account and all data
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Account deleted

  /api/users/me/password:
    put:
      summary: Change password while logged in
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [current_password, new_password]
              properties:
                current_password:
                  type: string
                new_password:
                  type: string
                  minLength: 8
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Password changed
        '401':
          description: Current password incorrect

  /api/categories:
    get:
      summary: List all categories for the current user
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      responses:
        '200':
          description: List of categories
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
    post:
      summary: Create a category
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [name]
              properties:
                name:
                  type: string
                color:
                  type: string
                  description: Hex color code
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Category created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        '409':
          description: Category name already exists for user

  /api/categories/{id}:
    patch:
      summary: Rename or update a category
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              properties:
                name:
                  type: string
                color:
                  type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated category
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Category'
        '404':
          description: Category not found
    delete:
      summary: Delete a category (tasks become uncategorized)
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Category deleted

  /api/tasks:
    get:
      summary: List tasks with optional filters and sorting
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: category_id
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
        - name: status
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [all, active, completed]
        - name: priority
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [low, medium, high]
        - name: due
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [today, this_week, overdue]
        - name: search
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: sort_by
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [due_date, created_at, priority, title]
        - name: sort_dir
          in: query
          schema:
            type: string
            enum: [asc, desc]
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Filtered and sorted task list
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
    post:
      summary: Create a task
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskInput'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Task created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ValidationError'

  /api/tasks/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get a single task
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Task detail
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
        '404':
          description: Task not found
    patch:
      summary: Update a task
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/TaskInput'
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated task
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'
    delete:
      summary: Delete a task
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      responses:
        '204':
          description: Task deleted

  /api/tasks/{id}/complete:
    patch:
      summary: Toggle task completion status
      security:
        - bearerAuth: []
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              type: object
              required: [completed]
              properties:
                completed:
                  type: boolean
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Updated task
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Task'

components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
  responses:
    ValidationError:
      description: Validation failed
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            type: object
            properties:
              errors:
                type: array
                items:
                  type: object
                  properties:
                    field:
                      type: string
                    message:
                      type: string
  schemas:
    AuthResponse:
      type: object
      properties:
        token:
          type: string
        user:
          $ref: '#/components/schemas/User'
    User:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        email:
          type: string
        display_name:
          type: string
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
    Category:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        name:
          type: string
        color:
          type: string
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
    Task:
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
        title:
          type: string
        description:
          type: string
          nullable: true
        due_date:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          nullable: true
        category_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          nullable: true
        priority:
          type: string
          enum: [low, medium, high]
        completed:
          type: boolean
        is_overdue:
          type: boolean
        created_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
        updated_at:
          type: string
          format: date-time
    TaskInput:
      type: object
      properties:
        title:
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 200
        description:
          type: string
          nullable: true
        due_date:
          type: string
          format: date-time
          nullable: true
        category_id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          nullable: true
        priority:
          type: string
          enum: [low, medium, high]
components.componentAgentInstructions:
Implement a Go REST API using only the standard library (net/http, encoding/json) plus the following well-known packages: github.com/google/uuid (UUID generation), golang.org/x/crypto/bcrypt (password hashing), github.com/golang-jwt/jwt/v5 (JWT), and github.com/lib/pq or pgx (PostgreSQL driver). Listen on port 9090.

## Project Structure
```
/task-api
  main.go
  Dockerfile
  go.mod
  internal/
    db/          # DB connection and migrations
    handlers/    # HTTP handlers grouped by domain
    middleware/  # Auth, logging, CORS
    models/      # Structs: User, Task, Category
    auth/        # JWT helpers, password helpers
```

## Database
Use PostgreSQL. On startup, run embedded SQL migrations to create the following tables:

```sql
users (id UUID PK, email TEXT UNIQUE, display_name TEXT, password_hash TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ);
password_reset_tokens (id UUID PK, user_id UUID FK, token_hash TEXT, expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ, used BOOLEAN);
categories (id UUID PK, user_id UUID FK, name TEXT, color TEXT, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ, UNIQUE(user_id, name));
tasks (id UUID PK, user_id UUID FK, category_id UUID FK NULLABLE, title TEXT, description TEXT, due_date TIMESTAMPTZ NULLABLE, priority TEXT CHECK(priority IN ('low','medium','high')), completed BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, created_at TIMESTAMPTZ, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ);
```

## Authentication
- Issue signed JWTs (HS256) with a configurable secret (env: JWT_SECRET). Token expiry = 30 minutes.
- Middleware extracts Bearer token from Authorization header, validates it, and sets user_id in request context.
- All /api routes except /api/auth/* require this middleware.
- Password reset: generate a secure random token, store its bcrypt hash in password_reset_tokens with 1-hour expiry. Send the raw token in an email (use env: SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, SMTP_FROM). On confirm, verify token hash, ensure not expired/used, update password, mark token used.

## Password Validation
Server-side enforce: min 8 chars, at least one digit ([0-9]), at least one special character ([^a-zA-Z0-9]).

## Task Listing — Filtering & Sorting
Build a dynamic SQL query based on query parameters:
- category_id: WHERE category_id = $n
- status=active: WHERE completed = FALSE; status=completed: WHERE completed = TRUE
- priority: WHERE priority = $n
- due=today: WHERE due_date::date = CURRENT_DATE AND completed = FALSE
- due=this_week: WHERE due_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '7 days' AND completed = FALSE
- due=overdue: WHERE due_date < NOW() AND completed = FALSE
- search: WHERE (title ILIKE '%' || $n || '%' OR description ILIKE '%' || $n || '%')
- All active filters combined with AND.
- sort_by: map to column name (whitelist only); sort_dir: ASC or DESC (default: created_at DESC).
- Compute is_overdue on each returned task: due_date IS NOT NULL AND due_date < NOW() AND completed = FALSE.

## Ownership Enforcement
All queries must include AND user_id = <authenticated user id>. Never return data belonging to another user. Return 404 (not 403) when a resource is not found for the authenticated user.

## Input Validation
Return structured errors: `{"errors": [{"field": "title", "message": "must be between 1 and 200 characters"}]}`.

## CORS
Allow requests from the frontend origin (env: FRONTEND_ORIGIN, default: *). Allow headers: Authorization, Content-Type.

## Environment Variables
- PORT (default: 9090)
- DATABASE_URL (postgres connection string, required)
- JWT_SECRET (required)
- FRONTEND_ORIGIN (default: *)
- SESSION_TIMEOUT_MINUTES (default: 30)
- SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASS, SMTP_FROM (for password reset emails)

## /health Endpoint
GET /health → {"status": "ok", "db": "ok"} (also ping the DB); return 503 if DB is unreachable.

## Dockerfile
Multi-stage: stage 1 — golang:1.22-alpine to build binary; stage 2 — alpine:latest, copy binary, EXPOSE 9090, ENTRYPOINT ["./task-api"].

components.componentAgentInstructions:
Implement a React 18 single-page application using TypeScript, Vite, React Router v6, and TailwindCSS. Communicate with the task-api backend via fetch (base URL read from env variable VITE_API_BASE_URL).

## Project Structure
```
/task-web
  Dockerfile
  index.html
  vite.config.ts
  tailwind.config.ts
  src/
    main.tsx
    api/          # Typed fetch wrappers for each API resource
    components/   # Reusable UI: Button, Input, Modal, Badge, Spinner
    pages/        # Login, Register, ForgotPassword, Tasks, TaskDetail, Settings
    context/      # AuthContext (token storage, user state)
    hooks/        # useTasks, useCategories, useAuth
    types/        # Task, Category, User, AuthResponse interfaces
    utils/        # date helpers, priority color maps, validation
```

## Authentication & Session
- Store JWT in memory (not localStorage) with a fallback to sessionStorage for page refresh.
- On every API call, attach Authorization: Bearer <token>.
- Intercept 401 responses globally and redirect to /login, clearing the stored token.
- Implement inactivity tracking: reset a 30-minute timer on any user interaction; on timeout, log the user out and show a "Session expired" toast.
- Protect all routes except /login, /register, /forgot-password with an auth guard.

## Pages & Features

### Login (/login)
- Email + password fields with client-side validation (required, valid email, password min 8 chars).
- Show field-level error messages from the API response.
- Link to register and forgot password.

### Register (/register)
- Email, display name (optional), password, confirm password.
- Client-side: match passwords, enforce complexity (8+ chars, 1 digit, 1 special char).
- Show field-level API errors.

### Forgot Password (/forgot-password) and Reset Password (/reset-password?token=...)
- Simple email input form; success shows a generic confirmation message.
- Reset form: new password + confirm; validate complexity.

### Task List (/ — main page)
Layout: sidebar with category list + filter controls; main area with task list.

**Filter & Sort Controls:**
- Category selector (All + user categories with color dots)
- Status tabs: All / Active / Completed
- Priority filter: All / Low / Medium / High
- Due date filter: All / Today / This Week / Overdue
- Search input (debounced 300ms, sends to API)
- Sort by: Due Date / Created / Priority / Title — with asc/desc toggle
- All filters send simultaneously as query params to GET /api/tasks.

**Task List Items:**
- Show title, priority badge (colored), category pill (colored), due date.
- Overdue tasks: red text or red left border.
- Undated tasks: show "No due date" in muted text.
- Checkbox to toggle complete/incomplete (calls PATCH /api/tasks/:id/complete).
- Click row to open Task Detail.
- Delete button with confirmation modal before calling DELETE.

**Create Task Button:** opens a slide-over or modal with the task form.

### Task Detail (/tasks/:id)
- Show all fields in an editable form.
- Save on blur or via explicit Save button.
- Priority shown with colored badge.
- Delete button with confirmation modal.

### Settings (/settings)
- Update display name / email form.
- Change password form (current + new + confirm).
- Delete account section with confirmation modal and warning text.

## Responsive Design
- Mobile: sidebar collapses to a slide-in drawer toggled by a hamburger button.
- All touch targets min 44px.
- Task list cards stack vertically on narrow screens.

## Error Handling
- Global error boundary catches unexpected JS errors.
- API errors show user-friendly toast notifications (top-right, auto-dismiss 5s).
- Form field errors shown inline beneath the relevant input.
- Network errors (fetch throws) show a "Connection error. Please try again." toast.

## Performance
- Use React.lazy + Suspense for route-level code splitting.
- Debounce search input 300ms.
- Optimistic UI for task completion toggle (revert on error).

## Environment Variables
- VITE_API_BASE_URL: backend API base URL (e.g. https://task-api.example.com)

## /health Route
Served by nginx: a static file at /health returning 200 with text "ok".

## Dockerfile
Multi-stage:
- Stage 1: node:20-alpine — install deps (npm ci), run vite build.
- Stage 2: nginx:alpine — copy dist/ to /usr/share/nginx/html, copy custom nginx.conf.
- nginx.conf: serve on port 80, all routes fallback to index.html (SPA routing), /health returns 200 "ok" from a static file.
- EXPOSE 80.
